figurative_meaning_en: At one time or in the past
example_sentences_in_bangla: এককালে এই গ্রামে সবাই খুব সুখী ছিল।
এককালে কলকাতায় ঘোড়ায় টানা ট্রাম চলত।
example_sentences_in_english: Once upon a time, everyone in this village was very happy.
In the old days, horse-drawn trams ran in Kolkata.
history: Refers to past eras, often evoking historical changes like the use of horse-drawn trams in Kolkata during the colonial period.
note: Commonly used to introduce nostalgic or historical anecdotes in Bengali speech and literature.
